title: Speaking — Choosing a seat
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on choosing a seat.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
Where do you normally sit on a bus or train?
Do you have a favourite place to sit while studying?

part2.topic: Describe a public place where the seating made people feel welcome.
part2.closing: and explain why the arrangement stood out to you.

questions: How can seating design help older people use public places?
What challenges arise when private businesses manage public gathering spaces?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to choosing a seat?
